test_value_counts: test the value_counts method that returns a Series with counts of unique values
test_unique: test the unique method that returns unique values of a Series or Index
test_factorize: test the factorize method that encodes values as enumerated integer codes and uniques
test_searchsorted: test the searchsorted method that finds insertion indices to maintain sorted order
test_drop_duplicates: test the drop_duplicates method that removes duplicate values from a Series or Index
test_to_numpy: test the to_numpy method that converts Series or Index values to a NumPy ndarray
test_nunique: test the nunique method that returns the number of unique elements excluding NaNs
test_empty: test the empty property that returns True if a Series or Index has no elements
test_is_unique: test the is_unique property that returns True if all values are distinct
test_argmax: test the argmax method that returns the integer position of the largest value
test_argmin: test the argmin method that returns the integer position of the smallest value
test_is_monotonic_increasing: test the is_monotonic_increasing property that returns True if values are non-decreasing
test_is_monotonic_decreasing: test the is_monotonic_decreasing property that returns True if values are non-increasing
test_hasnans: test the hasnans property that returns True if there are any NaN values
test_reset_cache: test the _reset_cache method that clears cached properties of a PandasObject
test_freeze: test the _freeze method that prevents adding new attributes to a NoNewAttributesMixin
